detailed_descriptions.en: Reaper Actual is an Open-World Persistent Shooter where players deploy into the field as Reapers (Tier 1 Operators) to engage in fast-paced FPS combat mixed with the persistence of an MMORPG. On the Island of Marova, players also have Bases which act as their home base for every deployment and extraction. Players can use their Base to brief & restock before they venture out on missions for and against the 5 NPC Factions that occupy Marova's infrastructure, as they acquire gear and level their Reaper, weapons, and gadgets. As you complete missions, you're likely to encounter other players as hundreds deploy across the island to engage in PvPvE battles for supremacy. Each deployment, make sure you are always looking over your shoulder for whoever may be ready to take a shot. With Air, Land, and Sea vehicles (coming soon) at their disposal, any Reaper can find themselves in one of Marova's 5 different biomes with missions ranging from intense HVT missions to collecting scarce resources needed for a deep crafting system.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Reaper Actual is an Open-World Persistent Shooter where players deploy into the field as Reapers (Tier 1 Operators) to engage in fast-paced FPS combat mixed with the persistence of an MMORPG. On the Island of Marova, players also have Bases which act as their home base for every deployment and extraction.

Players can use their Base to brief & restock before they venture out on missions for and against the 5 NPC Factions that occupy Marova's infrastructure, as they acquire gear and level their Reaper, weapons, and gadgets.

As you complete missions, you're likely to encounter other players as hundreds deploy across the island to engage in PvPvE battles for supremacy. Each deployment, make sure you are always looking over your shoulder for whoever may be ready to take a shot.

With Air, Land, and Sea vehicles (coming soon) at their disposal, any Reaper can find themselves in one of Marova's 5 different biomes with missions ranging from intense HVT missions to collecting scarce resources needed for a deep crafting system.
